scenarios.name: founding-carrier-minimum
scenarios.description: A commit created exactly at h_open reveals a founding artifact. A second reveal in the same block holds one satoshi less than MIN_CARRIER_FOUNDING and is rejected.

invalidEvents.detail: carrier holds 99999 sats, founding minimum is 100000

scenarios.name: commit-age-boundary
scenarios.description: Reveal height minus commit height must be at least COMMIT_MIN_AGE. An age of 143 fails, an age of 144 passes.

invalidEvents.detail: commit age is 143 blocks, minimum is 144

scenarios.name: open-era-carrier-minimum
scenarios.description: A commit created before h_open is never founding, so the open era minimum applies. One satoshi short fails, exactly MIN_CARRIER_OPEN passes.

invalidEvents.detail: carrier holds 9999 sats, open era minimum is 10000

scenarios.name: founding-window-edges
scenarios.description: The window is half open. A commit at h_open is inside, a commit at h_close - 1 is inside, a commit at h_close is outside and mints an open era artifact.

scenarios.name: grace-boundary
scenarios.description: A reveal at grace_end is still founding. The same shape one block later is a valid open era artifact with founding false.

scenarios.name: duplicate-marker-void
scenarios.description: Two PTNA payloads in one transaction void the marker. On a mint nothing is created. On a spend the KEEP is ignored and the default rule picks the successor.

invalidEvents.detail: outputs 0, 1 all carry a PTNA payload
outputs 0, 3 all carry a PTNA payload

scenarios.name: keep-single-entry
scenarios.description: A KEEP entry names output 2 while the default rule would have picked output 0. The named output wins.

scenarios.name: keep-eight-entries
scenarios.description: Eight carriers spent by one transaction, routed by a KEEP marker with the maximum eight entries. Input i goes to output 7 minus i.

scenarios.name: keep-entry-failures
scenarios.description: One KEEP marker carrying an entry for a non carrier input, an out of range output, an OP_RETURN output and an output below MIN_SUCCESSOR. Each void entry falls through to the default rule while the one good entry still routes.

invalidEvents.detail: input 4: input 4 does not spend a live carrier
input 0: vout 9 is beyond the 5 outputs
input 1: vout 3 is an OP_RETURN output
input 2: vout 2 holds 9999 sats, minimum is 10000

scenarios.name: keep-no-carrier-input
scenarios.description: A KEEP marker in a transaction that spends no live carrier is inert and records KEEP_NO_CARRIER_INPUT once.

invalidEvents.detail: no input of this transaction spends a live carrier

scenarios.name: keep-duplicate-input
scenarios.description: A KEEP payload naming input 0 twice fails to decode. The whole marker is inert, so the default rule picks the successor.

invalidEvents.detail: input index 0 appears more than once

scenarios.name: keep-bad-grammar
scenarios.description: A KEEP count of nine and a KEEP count of zero both fail to decode. The marker is inert and the default rule applies.

invalidEvents.detail: KEEP count is 9, allowed range is 1 to 8
KEEP count is 0, allowed range is 1 to 8

scenarios.name: seed-bad-grammar
scenarios.description: A non zero flags byte, a short payload, a non minimal push and a byte after the push all report SEED_BAD_GRAMMAR.

invalidEvents.detail: flags byte is 0x01, every bit is reserved at version 1
SEED payload is 17 bytes, expected 18
push is not minimal
script carries data after the marker push

scenarios.name: marker-unknown-op-and-version
scenarios.description: An op byte of 0x03, a version byte of 0x02, a payload with no op byte and a payload with no version byte.

invalidEvents.detail: op byte is 0x03
version byte is 0x02
payload has no op byte
payload has no version byte

scenarios.name: marker-too-large
scenarios.description: An OP_RETURN carrying an 82 byte PTNA payload makes an 85 byte scriptPubKey, above the 83 byte ceiling.

invalidEvents.detail: scriptPubKey is 85 bytes, ceiling is 83

scenarios.name: seed-semantic-failures
scenarios.description: Carrier out of range, carrier naming the marker output, no commit input at all, a commit leaf that does not bind this salt, and two qualifying commit inputs.

invalidEvents.detail: carrier vout 5 is beyond the 2 outputs
carrier vout 0 is an OP_RETURN output
no input reveals a PATINA commit leaf
1 commit leaf reveal(s), none commit to this salt and claimant key
2 inputs reveal a qualifying commit leaf, exactly one is required

scenarios.name: default-rule-successor
scenarios.description: With no marker at all the default rule picks the lowest index output that is not an OP_RETURN and holds at least MIN_SUCCESSOR.

scenarios.name: relic-creation
scenarios.description: A carrier spent into nothing but an OP_RETURN and a thin output leaves no eligible successor. The artifact becomes a relic and never changes again.

scenarios.name: bundle-of-three
scenarios.description: Three artifacts land on one output and become a bundle. One input carries one routing decision, so the next spend moves all three together and each appends its own ring.

scenarios.name: multi-block-replay
scenarios.description: Five consecutive blocks that mint, move by KEEP, idle, mint again and move, then end one artifact as a relic. Every height carries its own state root.

reorg.name: reorg-at-fork-height
reorg.description: Blocks 3001 through 3005 are applied, then the chain rolls back to 3003 and an alternate 3004 and 3005 are applied. The two branches end at different state roots, and the fork height root is shared.
